base.probability_evidence: Evaluation rationale: valuation is compelling (7.1x P/FCF, 10.3x P/E, below every 5y multiple minimum) but gross/FCF margin erosion, rising net debt/EBITDA (-0.41x FY23 -> 0.46x TTM) and no cited revenue-growth evidence mean the most likely path is per-share FCF compounding via the -7.83% YoY buyback (statistics page) at an unchanged 7.1x P/FCF, not a re-rating or de-rating.

jumps.reason: PayPal's weekly-return history shows outsized moves around quarterly earnings: 10 of the last 20 quarterly earnings weeks (2021-11 to 2026-07) saw a >=10% weekly move, and the next earnings date (2026-10-27) is a named near-term catalyst the bear case flags as able to confirm margin erosion.
